name: Gemma 4 12B (unified multimodal)
context_scaling: per-layer-type rope (full_attention theta 1e6 proportional / sliding_attention theta 1e4 default)
attention_variant: GQA + sliding-window/global hybrid with separate global head geometry (global_head_dim 512, num_global_key_value_heads 1)
notes: PARAMS: 11.96B is the safetensors count across text plus the unified vision and audio towers. ARCHITECTURE FLAG: model_type is gemma4_unified, not gemma4. Google's doc says the unified 12B is an ENCODER-FREE model for multimodal tasks, replacing the vision and audio encoders with direct linear projections of the input. There is therefore no ViT whose FLOPs dominate prefill for this model, which is the opposite of the usual VLM story and is exactly why it is worth its own record. KV left null for the same two-geometry reason: head_dim 256 with 8 KV heads on sliding layers versus global_head_dim 512 with 1 global KV head, across 8 global layers of 48. Audio is native on the 12B per Google's doc, which adds an audio-tower prefill cost not present in the text-and-image models. Ships with an MTP draft model.
